usage: The word '換衫' is commonly used to describe the action of changing clothes.
It can function as a verb phrase in a sentence, often combined with time expressions or places.
You can say '我換衫' to mean 'I change clothes'.
It can also imply changing into specific clothes, like work clothes or pajamas.
When giving a command, it can be used as '快啲換衫' meaning 'Change your clothes quickly.'
